purpose: Prevent authoritative native-4K evidence from being sealed with an omitted or duplicated display gamma transfer. Scene/PBR lighting remains linear through the floating-point HDR image-effect source; the filmic shader outputs linear LDR; the native non-HDR target owns the single Linear-to-sRGB encoding step before PNG readback.

authoritativeStillTargets.sourceDescriptor: RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32 + sRGB when project color space is Linear
authoritativeStillTargets.resolveDescriptor: copy of the source descriptor with msaaSamples=1
authoritativeStillTargets.readback: resolved sRGB LDR RenderTexture -> RGB24 Texture2D -> PNG

runtimeGuard.mechanism: InitializeOnLoad Camera.onPreCull fail-closed guard on the authoritative MainCamera targets

runtimeTelemetryBridge.purpose: The pre-cull target guard alone is insufficient: every actual OnRenderImage invocation must independently observe linear HDR input and sRGB LDR output before the capture manifest may be written.

visualFidelityPolicy.reason: Correct transfer plumbing is necessary for trustworthy pixels but does not prove that the resulting exposure, color, highlight rolloff, material response or composition is visually good.

failurePolicy.nativeTargetNotSrgb: FAIL authoritative still before culling and disable required tonemap so runtime receipt cannot seal
failurePolicy.anyOnRenderImageSourceNotLinearHdr: FAIL authoritative packet before manifest write
failurePolicy.anyOnRenderImageDestinationNotSrgbLdr: FAIL authoritative packet before manifest write
failurePolicy.manualTonemapGammaEncodingDetected: FAIL source preflight to prevent double encoding

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTextureReadWrite
researchReferences.use: In Linear color space, non-HDR color render textures normally use sRGB read/write conversion; HDR floating-point formats are always treated as linear data.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 RenderTexture.sRGB
researchReferences.use: Runtime read-only property used both by the formal MainCamera pre-cull guard and the image-effect telemetry to prove the expected transfer state.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 GL.sRGBWrite
researchReferences.use: Documents that fragment outputs are linear and non-HDR sRGB targets perform Linear-to-sRGB conversion in Linear color space; appropriate RenderTexture color-space flags are preferred over ad-hoc state switching.
